reference_sql:
SELECT SUM(ol.quantity) AS units
FROM order_lines ol
JOIN price_history ph ON ph.product_id = ol.product_id
WHERE ph.valid_to IS NULL
  AND ph.list_price_eur > 100
alternatives: WITH current_prices AS (SELECT product_id, list_price_eur FROM price_history WHERE valid_to IS NULL) SELECT SUM(ol.quantity) AS units FROM order_lines ol JOIN current_prices c ON c.product_id = ol.product_id WHERE c.list_price_eur > 100
SELECT SUM(ol.quantity) AS units FROM order_lines ol JOIN price_history ph ON ph.product_id = ol.product_id AND ph.valid_to IS NULL WHERE ph.list_price_eur > 100

other_way.sql: WITH current_prices AS (SELECT product_id, list_price_eur FROM price_history WHERE valid_to IS NULL) SELECT SUM(ol.quantity) AS units FROM order_lines ol JOIN current_prices c ON c.product_id = ol.product_id WHERE c.list_price_eur > 100
other_way.tradeoff: A named step of current prices shows its grain, one row per product, but the extra test in WHERE is the shorter fix.
